the design of a complete automatic parking assist system which can be implemented in series production vehicles.
the development of an automatic parking assistance system (APAS) that is able to park a vehicle in a parking space.
the development of an APAS for passenger cars which can autonomously detect a parking place, plan a feasible path, track this path and park into the parking place.
